price_field_note: Stuv (Monsma-distributed) price book publishes a single 'Price' column per unit, which is the wholesale/dealer price Benson pays. No separate MSRP/retail column is published; msrp left null. A 5% tariff surcharge is applied separately, calculated on MSRP, and is not reflected in these prices.
